name: Propylallyltryptamine
summary: Propylallyltryptamine (PALT), also known as N-propyl-N-allyltryptamine or by its developmental code name ASR-3004, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family. It is an asymmetrical analogue of dipropyltryptamine (DPT) and diallyltryptamine (DALT).

pharmacology.text: Propylallyltryptamine (PALT), also known as N-propyl-N-allyltryptamine or by its developmental code name ASR-3004, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family. The drug is a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT1B, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT6 receptors, but not of the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor. It is also a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is a research compound and is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，並不是核准的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，并不是核准的药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Tryptamine psychedelics as a group can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a faster heart rate and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。色胺類迷幻藥整體而言可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快和驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。色胺类迷幻药整体而言可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快和惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: PALT is a hybrid of DPT and DALT: its nitrogen carries one propyl group and one allyl group, a three-carbon chain with a double bond.
fact.zh: PALT 是 DPT 和 DALT 的混合體：它的氮原子上連著一個丙基和一個烯丙基，後者是一條帶雙鍵的三碳鏈。
fact.zhHans: PALT 是 DPT 和 DALT 的混合体：它的氮原子上连着一个丙基和一个烯丙基，后者是一条带双键的三碳链。
